purpose: Turn failed or marginal SakthiAI video-quality dimensions into concrete regeneration guidance without binding to a vendor or enabling runtime generation.

VQ-CONTENT-01.problem: Prompt or storyboard intent is missing, materially altered, or padded with unwanted scenes.
actions: Reduce the generation prompt to one shot objective at a time.
Make subject, action, environment, shot size, camera motion and duration explicit.
Remove conflicting style or motion instructions.
Regenerate only the failed shot instead of replacing an otherwise good sequence.

VQ-TEMPORAL-01.problem: Frame-to-frame motion, object permanence or geometry is unstable.
actions: Shorten shot duration and reduce simultaneous subject and camera motion.
Prefer a locked or simple camera move when the subject already has complex motion.
Use a stable reference/start frame where supported.
Split multi-action scenes into separate shots and assemble after each shot passes QA.

VQ-IDENTITY-01.problem: Character, face, clothing, product or reference identity drifts between frames or shots.
actions: Use the same approved reference asset for every shot requiring identity continuity.
Keep wardrobe, age, facial description, proportions and distinguishing features unchanged in prompts.
Avoid unnecessary angle or lighting changes during identity-critical moments.
Regenerate the drifting shot rather than accepting a high average score.

VQ-VISUAL-01.problem: Visible anatomy, object, texture, flicker, warping, ghosting or generated-text artifacts reduce quality.
actions: Simplify crowded scenes and reduce the number of independently moving objects.
Avoid asking the video model to render important readable text; add verified text in post-production instead.
Inspect hands, eyes, faces and object edges shot-by-shot and regenerate any dominant defect.
Prefer a cleaner source/reference frame before attempting enhancement or extension.

VQ-CAMERA-01.problem: Framing, focus, horizon, lighting continuity or camera motion distracts from the scene.
actions: Specify one camera move per shot and avoid contradictory dolly/pan/orbit instructions.
Define shot size and subject placement explicitly.
Use slower camera movement for scenes with dialogue, faces or detailed objects.
Maintain lighting direction and exposure intent across connected shots.

VQ-AUDIO-01.problem: Speech, music, timing, clipping or lip synchronization is visibly or audibly weak.
actions: Separate visual generation from final speech/audio mastering when the generator cannot maintain synchronization reliably.
Keep dialogue segments short and use one speaker at a time for lip-sync-critical shots.
Normalize dialogue/background balance and reject clipped or unintelligible speech.
For Tamil, require human pronunciation review before publish approval.

VQ-TEXT-01.problem: Captions or on-screen text are unreadable, incorrect, mistimed or outside safe framing.
actions: Do not rely on generative video frames for exact captions, names or important written content.
Add final text as a deterministic overlay after generation.
Verify spelling, language, timing, line breaks and mobile-safe margins.
Require human review for Tamil text before publishing.

VQ-DELIVERY-01.problem: Output has incorrect dimensions, duration, aspect ratio, black/frozen sections or incomplete start/end.
actions: Validate container duration, dimensions, frame rate and audio presence before editorial review.
Trim frozen tails and unintended blank frames rather than publishing them.
Render the target aspect ratio directly where possible instead of destructive cropping.
Recheck the final assembled export, not only the individual generated clips.

decisionGuidance.REJECT: Do not repair around a critical defect. Replace or regenerate the affected shot/output before further promotion.
decisionGuidance.REGENERATE: Use the lowest-scoring dimensions to drive a targeted regeneration pass; preserve already-good shots.
decisionGuidance.PREVIEW_CANDIDATE: Suitable for controlled internal preview only; address remaining dimensions below publish quality before release.
decisionGuidance.PUBLISH_CANDIDATE: Quality gate passed, but publishing still requires the recorded human review and all external release gates.
